sentences.en: Pop artists thrive on the adulation of their loyal fans.
sentences.zh: 流行艺术家们依靠忠实粉丝的追捧而兴盛。

sentences.en: On encountering the celebrity, the fans asked for his autograph.
sentences.zh: 遇到名人时，粉丝们请求签名。

sentences.en: The singer fought his way through the crowd of fans.
sentences.zh: 歌手挤过人群中的粉丝才得以出场。
